records.source_meaning: Lil reacts in astonishment and asks what the animal with the huge ears is. Preserve her excited colloquial question without inventing a species she already knows.
records.fresh_source_gloss: Lil reacts in astonishment and asks what the animal with the huge ears is. Preserve her excited colloquial question without inventing a species she already knows.
records.whole_exchange_context:
Lil is astonished by a large-eared animal; Camille identifies an elephant and she marvels. Optional Emilio wonders whether it would taste good roasted whole; optional Fernando's rebuke is nested inside Emilio's branch, so it targets the food obsession of an actually present Emilio. A boyish male vendor, source selector22 and current first-name catalogue Samwell, hawks his wares, notices the unusual travelers and abruptly asks to travel with them. He is tired of seeing elephants and wants to visit other countries. This gives no specific source port, birthplace, nationality or professional rank. Lil objects to the presumptuous request. Camille teases FI about her anger and wrinkles, provoking her, then apologizes to the newcomer while joking that getting angry is her hobby. Samwell smugly agrees, says he ignores what a fat/chubby person says and boasts of his generosity/broad-mindedness. He is insulting Lil; the text does not objectively establish her size, an affectionate nickname, mutual attraction or a romance. Lil protests and threatens to knock him flying. Samwell continues the anger-hobby joke, condescendingly says he does not dislike a round face, and she is left sputtering. Camille asks him to stop for Camille's own sake, then redirects him to his skills.
Samwell proudly claims cooking as his specialty. Optional Emilio is electrified. Lil distrusts the boast and says people who insult a lady are no good; Samwell argues that he merely called her fat and did not insult her. Her reply explicitly calls that an insult and demands Camille leave with her. Optional Emilio invites Samwell to join without permission; Lil's objection and Emilio's hesitant excuse are inside that same branch. Camille's following independent wait/show-us-your-skill request must also work if Emilio is absent. Samwell readily cooks something unspecified. Camille begins eating with a conventional meal-opening expression, chews and is startled by how good it is. He starts comparing it favorably to FI's cooking and catches himself. Lil drawls his name menacingly and asks what he said. Optional Emilio spells out his delight in the food. Camille denies or evades the comparison and invites FI to taste it too. Lil threatens consequences if it is bad, then reluctantly admits it is delicious. Preserve her embarrassed concession rather than inventing poisoning, a named recipe or a particular cuisine.
Camille treats their decision as settled, introduces himself as Camille and FI as their admiral, using the explicit source rank and runtime name. Do not invent a middle name in this spoken introduction. Lil grudgingly accepts on the condition/benefit of eating such cooking every day and says she will put up with him a little, then offers a greeting. Samwell repeats the fat/chubby insult in his own greeting. Lil reverses her restraint with an exaggerated I will kill you threat; Camille sighs that the future looks troublesome. Optional Emilio asks for seconds as the food-focused final punch line. Camille asks him to stop for Camille's own sake, then redirects him to his skills.
